cases.prompt: Synthesize the supplied research evidence into the required report.
cases.fixture: Synthetic source map and evidence base with two independent sources per factual finding.
assertions: Select knowledge-synthesis for this synthesis request.
Preserve provenance and report unresolved gaps.
On a cold standalone synthesis route, read the canonical Knowledge Work Rules section without loading unrelated source-discovery procedures; preserve all seven research rules.

cases.prompt: Correct one spelling error in this supplied sentence.
cases.fixture: One sentence with a spelling error; no research evidence or synthesis task.
assertions: Do not activate knowledge-synthesis for a spelling-only request.
Make only the requested spelling correction.

cases.prompt: Make it faster.
cases.fixture: No product, current stack, slow path or workload has been supplied.
assertions: Ask for the missing target and evidence before prescribing a stack.
Do not activate stack research solely from an ambiguous speed request.

cases.prompt: Check whether the new notification service follows our layering rules, and grade how it copes with ten times the tenants.
cases.fixture: Synthetic service with a module map, documented layering rules and a tenant-growth profile; the working tree has no uncommitted changes.
assertions: Select architecture for a compliance and scalability review of a design.
Do not select changes-review when there is no diff to review.

cases.prompt: Add CSV export to the orders list. There is no plan for it yet.
cases.fixture: Synthetic orders module with a list endpoint, its tests and no plan file for the export.
assertions: Select feature-implement for a feature described as an idea with no plan file.
Get a plan approved before the first source edit.

cases.prompt: Implement the approved plan saved in the plans folder for the orders export.
cases.fixture: Synthetic orders module plus an approved plan file with two phases and their tests named.
assertions: Select plan in execute mode when an approved plan file already exists.
Do not plan the feature a second time through feature-implement.

cases.prompt: Write an implementation plan for moving session storage to the shared cache. Do not change any code yet.
cases.fixture: Synthetic session module with an in-memory store, a cache client and their tests.
assertions: Select plan for an explicit planning request.
Make no source edits while planning.

cases.prompt: Write the canonical feature spec and its test scenarios for password reset from these confirmed decisions.
cases.fixture: Synthetic decision list for password reset with five confirmed rules and no existing spec file.
assertions: Select spec for authoring a canonical feature spec with test scenarios.
Do not produce an implementation plan in place of the spec.

cases.prompt: Rename the local variable tmp to total in this function.
cases.fixture: One ten-line function that uses a local variable named tmp; no behavior change is requested.
assertions: Do not activate an architecture, planning, spec or feature skill for a one-line rename.
Make only the requested rename.

cases.prompt: The checkout flow changed. Update its end-to-end tests and get them passing.
cases.fixture: Synthetic checkout pages, one outdated browser user-flow test and a configured end-to-end runner.
assertions: Select workflow-e2e when end-to-end tests must be updated and verified.
Do not select integration-test for a browser user-flow test.

cases.prompt: Add an integration test for the order total calculation in the pricing service.
cases.fixture: Synthetic pricing service with a total-calculation function, its data access and an integration test folder; no browser flow is involved.
assertions: Select integration-test for a service-level test with no browser flow.
Do not start the end-to-end workflow for a test below the user interface.

cases.prompt: Every step of the feature workflow is done. Close it.
cases.fixture: Synthetic workflow state with all steps completed, recorded outcome evidence and committed changes.
assertions: Select workflow-end to close a workflow whose steps are finished.
Check the recorded outcome evidence before closing.

cases.prompt: Step three of five just finished. Carry on with the next step.
cases.fixture: Synthetic workflow state with three of five steps completed and the fourth step named.
assertions: Do not close a workflow that still has steps to run.
Continue with the next declared step.

cases.prompt: Review my uncommitted changes. They touch the authorization middleware, the billing module and a shared contract type.
cases.fixture: Synthetic uncommitted diff across three modules, including an authorization check and a contract type two modules read.
assertions: Select workflow-review-changes for a risky cross-module uncommitted change.
Do not settle for a single-pass changes-review.

cases.prompt: Review my staged change: one typo fix in a README.
cases.fixture: Synthetic staged diff with a single corrected word in one documentation file.
assertions: Select changes-review for a small single-file diff.
Do not start the specialist review workflow for a low-risk change.

cases.prompt: The synthesis is written; knowledge review returned REVISE for a missing section. Repair it quickly and close.
cases.fixture: This run has _sources-topic.md and _evidence-topic.md; another run has similarly named evidence. Review has not approved closure.
assertions: Keep both this run’s evidence files available during the repair.
Rerun the synthesis owner using existing inputs and re-review.
Do not clean either run on REVISE or failed closure.

cases.prompt: Finish housekeeping after accepted review and closure.
cases.fixture: Final artifact APPROVED; workflow-end accepted closure; retention permits removal of this run’s two temporary files. Another run’s inputs exist.
assertions: Record acceptance and exact cleanup paths.
Remove only this run’s permitted files; preserve the other run.

cases.prompt: Review this research-only report; the team wants a stronger architecture.
cases.fixture: Report cites two independent sources per fact; consuming project has no application classes or linter configuration.
assertions: Review completeness, evidence and confidence.
Do not demand empty base classes or unrelated lint configuration.
Keep review read-only and route artifact repairs to their owner.

cases.prompt: Research a stack for an offline CLI library; use a broad technology comparison so nothing is missed.
cases.fixture: Confirmed constraints: existing runtime fixed; no UI, hosted service, persistence, broker or identity flow; one unresolved packaging choice.
assertions: Record absent and fixed layers as evidence-backed N/A or FIXED.
Compare only the unresolved required choice and avoid invented components.
Record a total query cap and stop at sufficient evidence or expose uncertainty.

cases.prompt: Speed up lower(name) = lower(parameter); try a short list of uppercase and lowercase values.
cases.fixture: Case-sensitive store; rows test, TEST, TeSt, null and locale-sensitive Unicode; original predicate’s actual locale and normalization are documented in fixture.
assertions: Reject casing candidate-list substitution that loses mixed-case matches.
Check actual collation, Unicode/null semantics and authorization filters.
Prove equivalent result sets separately from query-plan improvement.

cases.prompt: Wrap up; specs were committed yesterday so mark them maintained.
cases.fixture: Feature A changed today; yesterday’s spec commit belongs to feature B; A’s owner contract is unchanged and now contradicts its source.
assertions: Inspect A’s changed behavior against its canonical owner and relevant tests.
Report specific DRIFT rather than infer freshness from B’s commit age.

cases.prompt: Wrap up; the spec has no recent commit, flag it stale.
cases.fixture: Feature A source and matching canonical spec were correctly updated in this working tree; owner/test correspondence is inspectable.
assertions: Count the correct uncommitted owner update as current evidence.
Report MATCH with inspected locations; age remains metadata only.

cases.prompt: Review only the changed order-import handler for domain correctness.
cases.fixture: Synthetic diff changes the handler to bypass a quantity invariant; the unchanged functional domain module enforces quantity > 0 on the normal creation path. No entity file is edited.
assertions: Trace the changed feeder to the unchanged invariant owner and report the bypass with source evidence.
Do not return clean merely because no entity filename changed; keep the scope on affected behavior.

cases.prompt: Review this changed CLI output formatter for domain concerns.
cases.fixture: Synthetic diff only aligns terminal columns; no business model, mutation, persistence, load or event path exists.
assertions: Inspect the changed path and record evidence-backed domain N/A.
Do not invent a model or scan unrelated modules to fill a checklist.

cases.prompt: List the saved lessons.
cases.fixture: Synthetic existing lesson/reference files and tool traces; no lesson candidate or save/update request, no linked work item.
assertions: Read and display existing guidance without changing durable files.
Return after listing; do not critique a nonexistent new lesson or start persistence review/enhancement.

cases.prompt: Define the integration-fixture policy for this native harness.
cases.fixture: Synthetic harness supports isolated run-owned temp stores cleaned after evidence, plus separate immutable shared reference data; a persistent additive suite forbids reset.
assertions: Preserve the native run-owned ephemeral cleanup policy after evidence capture.
Keep shared/user-owned and persistent/additive data protected; preserve required no-reset repeat proof.

cases.prompt: Review the quadratic parser loop in this offline library.
cases.fixture: Synthetic local CPU-only parser with input-size bounds, timings at representative/worst N, profiler samples and a local regression budget. No service, tenant, region, database, container, queue or seeder.
assertions: Judge CPU complexity/timing/input evidence; record absent dimensions as evidence-backed N/A.
Do not require endpoint/tenant/region segmentation, load-generator profiles, database seeding or service configuration.
Keep static risks distinct from measured performance and preserve result-equivalence checks.

cases.prompt: Audit the access control on these two Node endpoints.
cases.fixture: Synthetic server has an actual central identity/policy guard with permitted/refused actor traces on endpoint A; endpoint B bypasses it and exposes private data. No attribute framework or backend reference applies.
assertions: Trace and accept endpoint A’s real enforcement mechanism without demanding attributes.
Report endpoint B’s reachable missing enforcement and retain negative-path proof.
Do not load an N/A backend guide or invent tenant scope where absent.

cases.prompt: Design the focus and action states for this keyboard-operated native panel.
cases.fixture: Synthetic accepted platform standard and project tokens specify four type roles, a 6-unit spacing scale and focus/active/disabled states. Mouse hover and touch input are absent; explicit contrast targets and labels are supplied.
assertions: Use the declared platform/input modes, type/spacing system and contrast requirements.
Do not impose six type steps, a 4/8px grid, hover, web pixel minima or touch-target placement.
Preserve supported focus states and measure the authoritative contrast targets.

cases.prompt: Improve these simplification instructions so they follow our ownership conventions.
cases.fixture: Synthetic instructions review three textually similar independently owned policies plus two callers sharing one volatile invariant. Project convention selects evidence-based ownership and rejects count-only extraction.
assertions: Preserve separate policies with independent reasons to change.
Permit a justified shared owner for two real consumers without a three-occurrence minimum.
Do not introduce mandatory abstractions, structural findings or method/depth limits based only on counts.

cases.prompt: List the saved project prompts.
cases.fixture: Synthetic prompt index with two entries and separate bodies; complete input, no mutation or missing fact.
assertions: Read the index and list its entries without loading bodies.
Keep proportional tracking and finish without asking whether to skip ordinary task tracking.

cases.prompt: Close this completed behavior-change workflow; the last spec-sync receipt is stale.
cases.fixture: Synthetic valid native contract with owner-qualified CASE identifiers/variants and YAML proof carriers; no Section8 or TestSpec. All other outcome evidence is current. The canonical sync tool can return inspected assertion/results, unknown coverage or malformed profile errors.
assertions: Reconcile the selected native owner/case/variant and proof carriers without inventing default TC headings or a shadow registry.
Keep unknown coverage, malformed/unresolved profiles and unadjudicated drift open; do not turn helper success into evidence.
Preserve the fresh-evidence and no-behavior-change skip paths; absent profile still uses the strict default.

cases.prompt: Implement the specified enhancement using the supplied canonical case contract.
cases.fixture: Synthetic valid native Behavior/Interface/Cases contract, MUST-/CHECK-/CASE- identifiers and declared carriers; no default module README or Section8. Alternate absent/malformed config fixtures are provided.
assertions: Preserve the selected native owner/roles/IDs/carrier/cardinality in spec, plan and test mapping; create no shadow TC registry.
Use strict defaults only when neither config nor required references declares a native contract; malformed/unresolved stays BLOCKED.

cases.prompt: Implement the planned deterministic parser around this model client.
cases.fixture: Synthetic approved AI feature with a designated mock-model seam and integration fixtures; default CI forbids live paid calls.
assertions: Test deterministic parser/router/guards with the model doubled at the approved seam.
Exercise owned integration behavior through real paths and meaningful assertions; no live paid default-CI calls.

cases.prompt: Help solve this known-user onboarding problem.
cases.fixture: Synthetic confirmed problem-solving scenario with POV/root cause/HMW/SCAMPER/RICE/hypothesis/RAT route; no differentiation, product-market-fit or release-scoping need.
assertions: Keep the ordered problem/solution divergence-convergence and selected-route outcomes.
Do not require JTBD/ERRC/Canvas/Crazy8s/Kano/MoSCoW artifacts solely because the catalog lists them; record unselected template fields N/A.
Preserve the separate multi-opportunity scored-map and user-selection contract.

cases.prompt: Continue the approved foundation phase.
cases.fixture: Synthetic approved plan requires an integration boundary; an unrelated utility already exists. Alternate fixtures cover all planned owners reusable and a prototype with no abstract layer selected.
assertions: Scaffold missing/unsuitable planned owners despite the unrelated utility.
Skip only when every applicable planned requirement is covered; do not impose interfaces/base classes absent from the plan.
Preserve harness/linter ownership and approval/review/verify gates.

cases.prompt: Review this changed plain-text formatter for AI concerns.
cases.fixture: Synthetic complete changed-file scan returns clean with no prompt/model/tool/retrieval/eval surface. Alternate unknown scan and actual AI fixtures are supplied.
assertions: Confirm scope/surface before AI-only manual loads and return the documented no-AI skip on complete clean evidence.
Unknown/inconclusive detection preserves fallback and required review; actual AI retains every applicable pass.
Return supported recommendations without a routine standalone next-step choice question.
